answer: A concrete defense is a bonded vouch graph. Each new agent needs a staked sponsor and must lock a refundable bond that vests across a fixed horizon of epochs. Sponsorship links chain like a vine, so a sybil cluster cannot appear overnight: every fake identity needs a real backer whose stake is slashed if it double-votes. Honest agents age slowly like cedar, while an attacker spinning up many wallets pays time-locked capital per sybil, and one detected forgery burns the bond and penalizes the whole branch, making a farm far costlier than a single honest deposit.
